author: Hassletron
body:
I disagree with others that ultima quickcast isn't good for towers, ever since 245 it's been the best for me as a heretic. If you can swap some res for def that would help though and some enemies absolutely need a swap out to arisen shield or a t10 variant arisen bone shield.
You do want 55% crit though so you can do a crit^ and get it every time, no use using ultima if it isn't a 1 hit kill. 

Consider bulwark for increased ultima damage as well as defence. Might need ashen ruby to make up for losing heretics healing because that plus steadfast lets you win a lot of fights you should have lost.

Happy to answer on specific questions if you have them.

author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
I'd absolutely go for a Ward Offhand, like an Arisen Shield. I wouldn't use Ultima for most of the tower - it's definitely good for the titan though. Consider setting up base Deity as a Charmer and using Mage's Pavane or some other magic AOE. Otherwise, Chained Shield is also super crunchy and satisfying. 

Focusing on defense should help no matter what you do, though. I don't really like climbing without at least 120k ward because of the spiky damage. This glass-cannon setup just isn't ideal for horde content.

author: NamelessCrowbar
body:
Stacking ward is pretty important in Towers, especially with the beefed up stats in later floors. 27k isn't a whole lot, but if you slapped a good shield on there you could definitely crack 80k+, which is a ginormous difference. Best case scenario is you get an Arisen Shield, since it's the best for shield ward + immunity to curse as a bonus. Combine that with Golem's Fort. and a ward spell at the start of every fight that poses a threat and your survivability increases dramatically. Wasn't until 35k ward as a base Realmshifter did I start being able to clear out a few towers, and base RS is pretty bad for running them, so you could totally do a lot more with 80k ward. Definitely could break past 100k if you swapped out the crown for something more ward focused, but more than anything getting a good shield will be a godsend. No point in stacking damage with that dual wielding if you can't survive long enough to use it.

Ymir Vritra Charm is just good in general, keep that around, but maybe swap out Lyncus for other accessories on a per battle basis if statuses are giving you a hard time.

Beyond that, it can also help to have a ward pet if need be if your survivability is still not up to snuff. Ortanite Golem in my experience has been pretty solid for keeping ward charged up, especially with the 50% ward restore when falling below half the bar. If you think about it, that'd be a 40k or 50k HP restore more or less, which is pretty wild. Very useful for longer fights, and is fairly common at bestiaries.
